systems.system: Open Data Kit (ODK) campaign data collection, measles-rubella vaccination campaign
systems.platform: Open Data Kit (ODK) on mobile devices, feeding dashboards and maps
systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Expanded Programme on Immunization, with WHO support and Gavi funding
systems.tiers: campaign vaccination teams on Ndzuwani, Ngazidja and Mwali; campaign launched 4 October 2025; no facility tier stated

note: No fact: the only system is a data collection tool for one vaccination campaign, replacing paper forms for the first time; it is neither routine facility reporting nor a patient record.
